name: US total public debt outstanding, annual
description: Historical Debt Outstanding, the Treasury annual series of total public debt, back to 1790.
license: U.S. government work, public domain. Republished by Every Debt Clock (everydebtclock.com).
attribution: Source: Every Debt Clock (everydebtclock.com), from U.S. Treasury Historical Debt Outstanding
citation: Source: Every Debt Clock (everydebtclock.com), from U.S. Treasury Historical Debt Outstanding
update_schedule: Refreshed on the same daily run. Treasury updates Historical Debt Outstanding when it publishes a new fiscal-year figure. A completed fiscal year that is not in that annual series yet is added from the Debt to the Penny close on or before September 30, labeled with that source.
note: Fiscal year 1843 has two published records (1843-01-01 and 1843-07-01). Both are included. A row whose series is debt_to_the_penny_fiscal_year_end is a September 30 Debt to the Penny close for a year the annual series does not list yet.

columns.record_date: The date Treasury gives for that annual record.
columns.debt_outstanding_usd: Total public debt outstanding, dollars and cents, as published.
columns.source: Which Treasury series the row came from.
columns.series: historical_debt_outstanding, or debt_to_the_penny_fiscal_year_end when the annual series has not caught up.
